why: #529 G05: gogreen-federation.yml replayed these exact bytes from artifact 11968217957, which GitHub artifact retention deletes on 2026-10-29. A byte-exact replay cannot rebind to a 'latest' run (new run = new bytes), so the immutable archive is vendored and still verified against the same pinned digest.
transport: fetched by a read-only Actions job (run 39425232920) that verified the digest before emitting the bytes; re-verified locally (sha256 equal) before commit
